metadata.description: Canonical CS ontology entries for computer hardware components and architecture terms.
sources: Patterson & Hennessy – Computer Organisation and Design

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: The central processing unit; the primary component that executes instructions of a program.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: Arithmetic Logic Unit; a digital circuit that performs arithmetic and bitwise logic operations.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: Graphics Processing Unit; a specialised processor designed for parallel computation used in graphics and ML.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: Random Access Memory; volatile primary memory where the OS and active programs are stored.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: Read-Only Memory; non-volatile memory that retains data without power, stores firmware.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A small, fast memory component that stores copies of frequently accessed data to reduce access time.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A small, fast storage location within the CPU used to hold data being processed.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: The component of a CPU that directs the operation of the processor by fetching and decoding instructions.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: Hardware component that handles memory access requests from the CPU and translates virtual to physical addresses.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A communication pathway that transfers data between the CPU, memory, and peripherals.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: An open-source instruction set architecture (ISA) based on reduced instruction set computer principles.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A family of reduced instruction set computer ISAs developed by ARM Holdings.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A family of complex instruction set computer (CISC) ISAs originally developed by Intel.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A reconfigurable integrated circuit that can be programmed after manufacturing.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: An integrated circuit that contains the functions of a CPU on a single chip.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: The basic unit of time for a processor, determined by its clock frequency.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A technique where multiple instruction phases are overlapped to improve CPU throughput.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A communication system that transfers data between components inside or between computers.

entries.label: HARDWARE
entries.definition: A physical connection point through which a computer can receive or transmit data.
